import networkx as nx

G = nx.cycle_graph(11)
girth = nx.girth(G)
degrees = [d for n, d in G.degree()]

print(f"Girth: {girth}")
print(f"Min degree: {min(degrees)}")
print(f"Max degree: {max(degrees)}")

edges = []
for i in range(11):
    u = i
    v = (i + 1) % 11
    if u > v:
        u, v = v, u
    edges.append((u, v))
edges.sort()
flattened = []
for u, v in edges:
    flattened.extend([u, v])
print(flattened)
